title: Ibanga
subtitle: Reba abashobora kubona amakuru yawe, abayarebye, kandi usabe ko hagira ibikosorwa.

whoCanSee.title: Abashobora kubona amakuru yanjye
whoCanSee.body: Itsinda rikwitaho ku kigo nderabuzima n'umujyanama w'ubuzima ugusura bashobora kubona ibipimo byawe n'intambwe zikurikira. Wowe ubona ibyo itsinda rikwitaho ryagusangije.

whoLookedBody: Abantu bafunguye amakuru yawe muri iri gerageza, n'igihe babikoreye.

somethingWrong.title: Hari ikitari cyo?
somethingWrong.body: Niba hari ikintu kiri mu makuru yawe gisa n'aho atari cyo, saba itsinda rikwitaho kukigenzura. Amakuru yawe ntahinduka kugeza babikoze.

notice.title: Itangazo ry'ibanga
notice.heading: ITANGAZO RY'IGERAGEZA — AMAGAMBO ATEMEJWE
notice.shownBody: Ibisubizo by'ibipimo byawe nyuma y'uko itsinda rikwitaho ribisuzumye, intambwe zikurikira mwumvikanyeho, kwibutswa wahisemo, n'ibyifuzo wohereje.
notice.whoBody: Wowe, umuntu wemewe n'amategeko kugukorera, n'itsinda rikwitaho ku kigo nderabuzima. Umuntu wese urebye amakuru yawe agaragara mu mateka y'abayarebye.
notice.storedBody: Muri iri gerageza abikwa kuri iki gikoresho gusa. Serivisi nyayo yabika amakuru mu Rwanda.
notice.choicesBody: Ushobora gutanga cyangwa gukuraho uruhushya igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, no gusaba itsinda rikwitaho gukosora ikintu gisa n'aho atari cyo.
notice.rightsIntro: Itegeko rirengera amakuru bwite n'ubuzima bwite riguha ubu burenganzira:

rights.correction: Gukosora — gusaba ko amakuru atari yo akosorwa.
rights.portability: Kwimura — guhabwa amakuru yawe ngo uyajyane ahandi.
rights.erasure: Gusiba — gusaba ko amakuru yawe asibwa.

notice.rightNotAvailable: Uburyo buzagenwa na Minisiteri; ntiburaboneka muri iri gerageza.

access.title: Abarebye amakuru yanjye
access.intro: Abantu bose bafunguye amakuru yawe muri iri gerageza. Amazina y'abakozi ntagaragazwa — hagaragara gusa umwanya wabo n'ikigo nderabuzima.
access.empty: Nta muntu urareba amakuru yawe muri iri gerageza.
access.filterEmpty: Nta kintu cyo kwerekana kuri iyi hitamo.

purpose.representative_access: Muri iyi porogaramu, mu izina rya {{name}}
